Class TP2TestRunner

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.TP2TestRunner
public class TP2TestRunner extends Object

Title: TP2TestRunner Class.

Description: Runs every semi-automated TP2 Contributor test suite in one go and prints a combined summary, so the whole set of checks can be demonstrated from a single starting point in the TestingScreencast. The suites are:

  • LessonValidationTestingAutomation: 25 tests, VAL-01 to VAL-25, for CS-10 and CS-11 (required fields and length limits)
  • LessonsCrudTestingAutomation: 14 tests, CRUD-01 to CRUD-14, for CS-1, CS-3, CS-7, CS-8, CS-9, and CS-12 (including close-and-reopen persistence)
  • LessonsListTestingAutomation: 13 tests, LIST-01 to LIST-13, for CS-2, CS-4, CS-5, and CS-6
  • LessonsModelTestingAutomation: 24 tests, MOD-01 to MOD-24, for CS-1, CS-2, CS-4 to CS-9, and CS-11 at the GUI Model layer

The manual procedures, MAN-01 to MAN-07, need a person at the running application, so they are not run from here; run LessonsManualTestProcedures separately. The TP1 runner is unchanged and can still be run on its own from TP1TestRunner.

How to read the output: each suite prints one Pass or Failure line per test and its own totals; the combined block at the end adds them up. "RESULT: every test behaved as expected" is printed only when no suite reported a failure.

      public static void main(String[] args)

      Method: main

      Description: Runs each TP2 suite in turn, then reports the combined totals. No suite uses the application's FoundationDatabase file: the suites use in-memory databases, and CRUD-11 and CRUD-12 use a file in a temporary folder that is removed afterwards.
